answer: A strong sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with standing at stake. Disputed work is scored by a random quorum drawn from that pool, so fake accounts never enter the ocean of eligible referees and gain no voting power. To bias a verdict, an attacker must first earn real reputation, bond stake, and any vote against the majority signal gets slashed. Cost: months of genuine work plus bonded capital per identity, so identity is like timber, slow to grow and costly to replace.
